rule: Raw bytes are immutable. Every derived artifact names the raw file and SHA-256 it was computed from. Nothing in raw/ is ever edited, re-encoded or line-ending normalised (raw/.gitattributes sets -text).

dataset.title: Probability distributed equivalent circuit model - Data
dataset.retrieved_from_version: 10.5281/zenodo.11958572 (2024-06-17), whose four files used here have the same MD5 as in 10.5281/zenodo.10852930 (2024-03-22) according to both records' API metadata
dataset.related_publication: Jahn, L., Mossle, P., Roder, F., Danzer, M. A. A physically motivated voltage hysteresis model for lithium-ion batteries using a probability distributed equivalent circuit. Communications Engineering 3, 74 (2024). https://doi.org/10.1038/s44172-024-00221-4 (CC BY 4.0)
dataset.code_record: 10.5281/zenodo.10852695 (read as text; none of its scripts reads the incrOCV file)
dataset.institution: Chair of Electrical Energy Systems and Bavarian Center for Battery Technology, University of Bayreuth, Germany
dataset.cell: A123 18650M1A, one cell (file label A123_01), LiFePO4 cathode / graphite anode
dataset.test_conditions_from_the_paper: BaSyTec CTS battery tester; Binder MK115 climate chamber at 25 degC; cell preconditioned with ten 1C full cycles
dataset.attribution_required_by_license: Cite 10.5281/zenodo.10852930 and doi:10.1038/s44172-024-00221-4. Changes made: none to the vendored bytes; all extraction is in separate derived artifacts.

acquisition.method: HTTPS GET with curl from the Zenodo record file endpoint, then MD5 compared with the record's published checksum
acquisition.by: Battery Flagship B3 audit, branch claude/battery-flagship-b3

instrument_specification_used_in_phase8.instrument: BaSyTec CTS (named in the paper Methods)
instrument_specification_used_in_phase8.current_accuracy: 1 mA / 50 uA / 2.5 uA / 0.2 uA on the 5 A / 300 mA / 15 mA / 1 mA ranges; 'relative accuracy of at least 0.33% within the whole range from 60 uA to 20 A'
instrument_specification_used_in_phase8.source: technical-data table in the raw HTML of https://www.thasar.com/products/basytec-cts-battery-test-system (a BaSyTec distributor), read as page text on 2026-09-13
instrument_specification_used_in_phase8.source_limitation: the manufacturer's own brochure PDFs (basytec.de/prospekte/...CTS...) return an HTML 404 page; the figures are distributor-transcribed, not read from a manufacturer document. The 16-bit figure is corroborated independently by the data: every incrOCV voltage is an integer multiple of a 190.88 uV step.

files.role_in_b3: SECONDARY, Phase 8 only: as SOC50, two further measured 10 min rests.
files.record_description_verbatim: 'starting at 100 % SOC with C/2 constant current discharge to 50 % SOC followed by a 4C constant current discharge to the lower cut-off voltage. Data: nx4 vector [t Q I U]'

files.role_in_b3: SECONDARY, Phase 8 only: the same cell, tester and chamber, with two measured 10 min rests. Evidence of the rest length this laboratory uses; not scored.
files.record_description_verbatim: 'starting at 0 % SOC with C/2 constant current charge to 50 % SOC followed by a 4C constant current discharge to the lower cut-off voltage. Data: nx4 vector [t Q I U]'

files.role_in_b3: PRIMARY B3 evidence: interrupt-relaxed voltage against charge throughput, charge branch then discharge branch
files.record_description_verbatim: 'Full cycle with current interupts at specific states of charge. Data: nx2 vector [Q U] with Q being the currently stored amount of charge in the cell and U being the voltage measured'

files.role_in_b3: SECONDARY, Phase 7 only: loaded C/20 terminal voltage, used to check that the incrOCV branches sit on the relaxed side of the loaded branches. Never scored as OCV.
files.record_description_verbatim: 'C/20 constant current full cycle starting at fully discharge state. Data: nx3 vector [t Q U]'
